answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and runs one hollow waypoint. A raven courier brings a key-bound pass stamped by the waypoint. An auditor recomputes the zephyr drift-adjusted arrival window from a public drift table; a stamp outside the window or a reused pass burns the bond. The kth waypoint pays a route fee of 25+5(k-1) credits, so the 1000th pays 5020 and 1000 fakes lock 70000 plus 2522500 in fees. A rented-waypoint ring fails because a rented stamp key does not match the pass and a duplicate pass burns both bonds. An honest agent pays one bond plus 25, recovered after a clean epoch.
